name: Succubus Kitarite Tsuri o Suru
original_name: サキュバス来りて釣りをする
source:
In an age where terrestrial civilization has advanced and succubi are thought of as “legendary creatures,”
the protagonist, Famu, is a pure-blooded succubus born for the first time in centuries,
with the power to control others and turn them into succubi/incubi.
Upon descending to the human world for the first time, she shows more interest in the new experience of fishing than in her supposed role of corrupting humans!?
translation:
在地球文明发达、魅魔被视为“传说中的生物”的时代，
主角法穆是几个世纪以来首次诞生的纯血统魅魔，
拥有控制他人并将其变成魅魔/梦魇的力量。
第一次降临人类世界时，她对钓鱼的新体验表现出比她所谓的腐蚀人类角色更感兴趣！？
